title: Ancient Discovery
description: Discover Ancient Remnants in the Overworld!
body:
Ancient Discovery is all about stumbling across **Ancient Debris** in the Overworld, making the hunt feel a lot rarer and more exciting. It turns an already valuable block into a hidden little treasure that feels great to find.




Update 1.1:

Now features a possibility to find Netherite Templates in the Overworld.
Ancient Debris is now affected by Fortune and Silktouch!
